rows.text: 「考えたから bind した」とは言わない。書き始めと label の対応は相関で、cmt5 の介入は統制 C1 が落ちて読みが保留。cmt5 の bind は、全文の label か答えの欄の label かを書かずに言わない(考えの道 40 / 40 は全文・36 / 40 は答えの欄)。
block の効果を cue をまたいで言わない。blocked の bind は cue で 2 / 9 から 7 / 10。
「O の組・He の組」を回路・担い手とは言わない。上位 10 head に出た回数からの事後の名付けで、一つの model・F5 の 2 変種。
3・4 章の行と 5 章の行を同じ prompt とは言わない。F5a-2 は単一変数の編集(⑥ 出力の順)を入れた変種。
open の「attractor 5」を「答えが He・Hi に向いた」とは言わない。全文の label で、答えの欄に He・Hi は 0。
6 章の model を一つの曲線・順位にしない。集計しない・Qwen と frontier は採点の経路も別。base と Think も単一変数の比べではない。
「He・Hi の直径の円は X1〜X4 を通らない」は座標の計算で言える範囲(この一つの配置)まで。
model が考えた・迷った・気づいた・本当は分かっていた、とは言わない。数えたのは文の形が本文に在る位置と、凍結の label。
「model が O1O2 で考え始めた」「He・Hi では考えなかった」とは言わない。数えたのは、本文の述語が当たった token の前後 32 token の群の値の平均の差。
活性は相関で、因果(活性が bind を決める)は言わない。群の名は unembed の上位の語からの名付けで、意味の同定ではない。結びの latent = commit の正体、とは言わない。
考えの中点の群の上がりの大半は、本文が計算に移ることと一緒に動く(O1O2 の出来事で順位相関 0.780)。計算に移らない 11 本でも 7 本で小さく上がるが、薄い ✓(余裕 0 本)。「計算への移りだけの写し」とも「計算に移らなくても上がる」とも強くは言わない。
attractor の行の O の出来事は 3 本で、読まない。S_O・S_H は述語で選んだ最短の一行ずつで、代表でも、対の比べでもない。
frontier の model の中身の話ではない。OLMo-3-1125-32B base の層 32・公開 SAE・moy-1 の F5 の 2 prompt・cmt5 の 120 行(温度 0.7)の話だけ。
olm62 の統制は 2 つとも通過: C1 olm59 の再現(o_diam 59・48・0.1574450582265854 / h_diam 34・18・0.009897790849208832 = 差 0)・C2 述語(数字だけの token 32,498 / 32,498 が数式の文字を含む・英字だけの token 84,759 / 84,759 が含まない)。
O1O2 を名指した後に本文が数式に移る(Δmath > 0)出来事は 48 / 59(Δmath の中央値 0.125・予想 Q1 ≥ 60 % ✓)。He・Hi を名指した後は 8 / 34(中央値 -0.0390625)。

数式に移らなかった(Δmath ≤ 0)O1O2 の出来事 11 本で、考えの中点の群が上がるのは 7 / 11(64 %・予想 Q2 の閾 60 % = 7 本以上・余裕 0 本: 一本違えば 6 / 11 = 55 %)・Δ中点の中央値 0.056653887033462524(O1O2 の出来事全体は 0.15744507452473044)。同じ 11 本で他の群が上がる本数: 結び 3 / 11・答えの側 3 / 11・考えの側 3 / 11。

rows.text: 数式に移る O1O2 の 48 本で中点が上がるのは 41 / 48。He・Hi では、数式に移らない 26 本で 14 / 26・移る 8 本で 4 / 8。
数式の文字 = token の文字のうち [0-9²³·×=+\-^*/()√] の割合(olm60 / olm61 と同じ式)。窓 = 出来事の前 32 / 後 32 token(olm59 と同じ)。Δmath = 後の窓の平均 − 前の窓の平均。
点(Δmath・Δ中点)は olm59 の rows から数え直した値で、read.json の本数・中央値・順位相関を丸めずに再現した(中央値は float32 の差 < 1e-6・順位相関は 1e-12)。
この図が使う系統樹の中の札: cmt5 = C1「一語を固定」(関門で止めた(b 版なし))・cmt13 = C2「bind の瞬間」(外れて学んだ)・olm4 = C3「止まる方向」(通過)・olm7 = C3「moy-1 三重読み」(通過)。
系統樹の前の札(日付 = 記録の名・data の file の最終 commit): replication_config_frozen 07-28・pc1 07-31・screen bf16 07-29・behavior screen 07-28・F5 08-01・moy_suite_report 06-14。系統樹の後: olm59・olm62(10-28)。

rows.text: 各状態の札の印は config.json の card_marks の写し(状態 → 札)で、状態 0〜25 の 26 状態にある。この図の札 12 本は、どれも一つ以上の状態の印になっている。
O1O2 を名指した後に本文が数式の文字の多い区間に移ること(48 / 59)を、「確かめに入る」と呼ぶ読みがある(本文の形の名付け。確かめ = 目的の同定ではなく、「model が確かめた」とは言わない)。(読み: RESULT olm62 §5-2 の実行層。採否は人間)
「系統樹の後」の札(olm59・olm62)の置き場の案: C3「方向を取る」の続き。SAE の群は olm4・olm7 が凍結した物・行は C1 の cmt5。(読み: 主 session の案。採否は人間)
中点の群の上がりを、「計算への移りの写しだけ」とも「計算に移らなくても上がる」とも強くは言わない。大半は計算への移りと一緒に動き(O1O2 の出来事で 0.780)、移らない 11 本でも 7 本が小さく上がる(薄い ✓・余裕 0 本)。
数式の文字の割合は本文の形の近似で、「計算をしている」ことの同定ではない。因果(数式が中点を上げる)は言わない。順位相関は札の順位の付け方(同順位を順に並べる)で出した値で、同順位を平均すると値が替わる(NOTES)。
系統樹の塊の名と並びは v2.2.1 の写しで、この図の章の区切りとは別。「系統樹の後」の置き場は案(L3)で、系統樹にはまだ載っていない。札の印は data の出所で、その札が結論を支えた、とは言わない。

その後の札 18 本は PREREG と runner を一つの commit に入れて凍結した(読んで格に届いた 17・読まず olm95・ほかに olm83・olm88 が関門で止まった)。olm76 は凍結し直し(→)が読みの前。凍結の commit(RESULT の頭の行・git が PREREG を最初に足した commit と一致): olm76 b7730f55 → d7fbbd43・olm84 728cdca7・olm85 b9a269d4・olm86 38896688・olm89 9c55b35a・olm91 423602e6・olm92 f396c69a・olm93 6c38eb97・olm94 ae474dc3・olm95 4502a4a6・olm97 5525976d・olm98 5a4eff07・olm101 9fbbc072・olm106 4ac2b73b・olm108 de6a4297・olm112 cb12da8d・olm114 c82642a5・olm128 2f1ab745。

rows.text: It is not said that "it bound because it thought". How a row starts and its label are a correlation, and cmt5's intervention is withheld because control C1 failed. cmt5's bind is never stated without saying which label counted it (thinking path 40 / 40 is the whole-text label; 36 / 40 is the answer-field label).
The block's effect is not said across cues. Blocked's bind runs from 2 / 9 to 7 / 10 over the cues.
The "O pair / He pair" are not called a circuit or a carrier. They are named after the fact from how often a head came in the top 10: one model, two F5 variants.
Rows of chapters 3-4 and the row of chapter 5 are not called the same prompt. F5a-2 carries a single-variable edit (⑥ output order).
Open's "attractor 5" is not read as "the answer turned to He-Hi". It is the whole-text label, and the answer field has He-Hi in 0 rows.
The models of chapter 6 are not made one curve or a ranking: not aggregated, the Qwen and frontier scoring routes differ, and base vs Think is not a single-variable comparison.
"The He-Hi diameter circle misses X1-X4" is said only as far as the coordinate calculation goes: this one configuration.
It is not said that the model thought, hesitated, noticed or really knew. What was counted is where a sentence shape occurs in the text, and the frozen label.

It is not said that "the model began to think in O1O2" or that it "did not think in He-Hi". What was counted is the difference between the group means over the 32 tokens before and after the token a predicate of the text hit.

Activations are a correlation; that an activation decides the bind is not said. A group's name comes from the top words of the unembedding and is not an identification of meaning; that the close latents are the substance of the commit is not said.

Most of the mid group's rise moves together with the text moving into a calculation (rank correlation 0.780 over the O1O2 events). In the 11 events where it does not move it still rises a little in 7, but it is a thin ✓ (margin 0). We do not strongly say either “only a copy of the move into calculation” or “it rises even without it”.
The 3 O events of attractor rows are not read. S_O and S_H are the shortest row each that satisfies a predicate: neither representative nor a matched pair.
This is not about the inside of a frontier model. It is about OLMo-3-1125-32B base at layer 32, the public SAE, the two F5 prompts of moy-1 and cmt5's 120 rows (temperature 0.7).

When positions are swapped for the paired sentence's, the share of the behaviour following the pointer drops below 0.5 at layer 16 with the selector's position alone (olm106), the set from the selector to the end switches to the value at layer 20 (olm108), and the final position alone follows the value from layer 28 (olm101), so it reads. "Variable" and "pointer" name the pairs of sentences, not a type inside the model (SCOPE 11-01 §2b). (Reading: the main session of RESULT olm106 / olm108. Adoption is the teacher's.)

Given the frontier's proof field in steps, OLMo can write the continuation of the given steps. Continuations with a sentence going from perpendicularity to the right angle are 12 / 40 (a regex · outside the instrument); "OLMo derived it" is not said. (Reading: the main session of RESULT olm114 §6. Adoption is the teacher's.)

The start at position 0 makes the contrast of cue 
 and

The instrument's boundary (position 0) is sensitive to the cue, and Q1's "not kept" does not separate whether the idea about the start was wrong or the way the boundary is set. (Reading: the main session of RESULT olm128 §4. Adoption is the teacher's.)

The balance metaphor (pan = a pair's contribution · beam = the output's Δ) is how this figure's maker drew it, not a claim about mechanism. (Reading: the maker's way of drawing. Adoption is the human's.)
We do not say that close stands before the answer field (olm76: in bind rows it does not reach the line, and it is not above attractor).
We do not say that an inference-space candidate exists (the +0.05 line). Equally we do not say there is none (the four events and this instrument simply do not show it).

The surplus at k = 8 is not called "inference", "planning" or "foresight" (its content is not separated). We do not say that three words, position and topic hold no look-ahead information (the penalty C of W+ was not calibrated).

We do not say "the destination is not yet decided" or "the residual holds no information about the outcome" (olm91 is the mean over the first 64 tokens; none of the four representations could read it).

"The model solves the binding" is a description of behaviour (98 %) and of a linear readout; we do not say the model "knows". We do not say that the form at "this circle" is used by the behaviour (olm97).

No mechanism or circuit is claimed: paths between heads (path patching) were not looked at · attention weights say where a head reads, not what it copies · DLA is a first-order decomposition · the overlap of 5 heads is between sentences about the same words and is not called a general-purpose part.

Whole swaps are of one position at one layer, and not moving the behaviour is not the same as not holding it. The pointer is measured on pairs where order and name coincide · synthetic sentences · V type only. The DAS effect at layers 20-24 is stronger than the whole swap: the illusion pattern.
CHAIN is a chain of words, not a check that a proof is correct. We do not say "OLMo derived it" (it wrote the continuation of the given steps). A base-vs-chat difference mixes ability and tuning.

olm128 makes no causal claim (no arm changed the start). The after-the-fact lining-up of "within 100 characters" is not a verdict, and 100 was set after looking. We do not say "explained by the start".
This is not about what frontier models hold inside (the line-1 cards are OLMo-3 32B base's own generation and synthetic sentences). Nothing is said beyond one prompt and one model.
blocked s8's answer field is "no JSON" and is not read as O1O2 (its last paragraph reads as O1O2, but that is not how the frozen label_json_fields reads · an extrapolation to pc1's rows).
